parsed.why: No trans-specific criminalisation or border bar; courts gave real remedies against restroom advice and surgery requirement. But pervasive discrimination, healthcare gaps and violent Pride opposition keep it below Low Risk.
Decriminalised with constitutional gender-identity protection and cultural third-gender acceptance; but no marker route, conservative society, police distrust and a documented 2018 trans murder.
No criminalisation or documented trans violence, but no marker-change route and documented frontier document mismatch for a trans traveller; no working remedy shown.
Universal ID-marker mismatch at checks, birth-sex custody with reported sexual assault, official anti-trans hostility, weak hate-crime recourse, and no working remedy offset these exposures.
Same-sex conduct criminalised with a five-year minimum, police harassment of LGBT people, no functioning LGBT organisations and hostile society; current non-enforcement only partly mitigates.
